section.item: EXCLUSIVELY ON Wii™ AND NINTENDO DS™

Mario and Sonic face off, and the Olympic Winter Games heat up!

The legendary rivalry explodes in an all-new winter sports competition. Get ready to test your Olympic Spirit as your favourite Mario and Sonic characters in this sports party game. You will take to the snow and ice of Vancouver, host of the 2010 Winter Games, in head-to-head competition, as well as events requiring solid teamwork. With an assortment of new challenging Dream Events and surprises from the world of Mario and Sonic, the stage is set for a winter Olympic experience like no other. Grab your Wii™ Remote/Nunchuk and Wii™ Balance Board and get ready to go for gold!

KEY FEATURES
  • Plenty of events: Prepare to compete in the Olympic Winter Games with your friends and family! A variety of Dream Events offer surprising objects and new character-specific moves. Sharpen your team-playing skills with new simultaneous cooperative play and get your fill of head-to-head rivalry in the popular competitive events.
  • Choose your favorite Mario and Sonic characters: Play as your favorite characters from the world of Mario and Sonic, including Luigi, Tails, Yoshi, Knuckles, Peach and Amy, each with unique movements and stats. A few new faces, like Donkey Kong and Metal Sonic, have also been added to the mix!
  • Play like the real thing: Simulate real-life movements using intuitive controls on the Wii Remote/Nunchuk and Wii Balance Board. Skate, ski and snowboard your way to glory, with single and multi-player (competitive and cooperative mode) offering fun for players of all ages and skill levels!
  • Multiple gameplay modes: Compete in single events in the individual mode and team mode, or challenge your friends to an entire Olympic competition! A new Wii exclusive “Festival Mode” also allows you to experience the full competitive Olympic campaign (single and multi-player). This includes new “Boss” competitions against unique Mario and Sonic characters.

Mario and Sonic face off and the Olympic Winter Games heat up!

The rivalry explodes in an all new winter sports adventure! Take to the snow and ice of Vancouver, host city of the 2010 Olympic Winter Games, and play as your favorite Mario and Sonic characters. With only one cartridge, up to 4 of your friends can download the events and play heated matches anytime, anywhere! But the fun doesn’t stop there… Exclusive to the Nintendo DS version, Adventure Tours lets you play as Mario or Sonic to complete numerous missions in an effort to save the 2010 Winter Games. Let the adventure begin!

KEY FEATURES
  • Plenty of events: Prepare to compete for gold in the Olympic Winter Games! Not only can you enjoy all the Olympic Winter sports, but a variety of Dream Events offer new character-specific moves and surprising objects from the worlds of Mario and Sonic. Get your fill of head-to-head rivalry in competitive events, or sharpen your individual skills in single play.
  • Choose your favorite Mario and Sonic characters: Play as your favourite characters from the world of Mario and Sonic, including Luigi, Tails, Yoshi, Knuckles, Peach and Amy, each with unique movements and stats. A few new faces, like Donkey Kong and Metal Sonic, have also been added to the mix!
  • Easy to use controls: With intuitive and easy to pick up and play controls, using the stylus, buttons or D-pad will become second nature as you compete for gold! Wi-Fi rankings and wireless functionalities add to the single and competitive multi-player fun! Also, your friends can download events from a single cartridge, so prepare to play with them anytime, anywhere!
  • Multiple modes of play: Compete in single events in the individual mode and with your friends in multiplayer mode. Multi-Round Matches also add variety to the fun! Also, the new DS-exclusive “Adventure Tours” offers you a mission-based story mode for a more in-depth and rich single-player experience. This promises you an exciting adventure filled with diverse missions, boss encounters and a chance to save the 2010 Olympic Winter Games.

Reach high speeds as you travel down a vertical drop down a snow-covered mountain and through a series of gates. Stay closer to the flags using the Wii Remote/Nunchuck or Wii Balance Board and you might accelerate faster and get a faster time! Activate your boost at the right time and speed past your opponents!

Pass, shoot and score your way to victory! With your Wii Remote/Nunchuk in hand, help your team get the puck past the other team’s goaltender and into the net, similar to soccer. By passing consecutively to teammates, charge-up the power in your puck for a better shot!

Find your rhythm and be the best! Skate around a icy track against an opponent. The key to win will be to maintain an even pace as you waive your arm and use the Wii Remote, moving similar to a real speed skater. Be sure to sprint on the final straight-away towards the finish!

Put your skills to the test as you race downhill weaving between gates at incredible speeds! Using your stylus and taking advantage of the straight-aways to gain speed and boost. Be sure to keep a sharp eye out for the poles or you’ll miss your turns!

Race against three others down slopes of rolling terrain and a series of jumps and ramps! Use the button controls and D-pad to maneuver well. You'll have to drift through turns, ride in the slipstream of your opponents and get boosts in the jumps to see who is the fastest!

Dive head first lying face-down on a sled into a tube of ice and reach incredible speeds! Use your stylus to steer smoothly through each turn and use your boost at the right time in the straight-aways to keep your speed high.

Mario is the world’s most famous plumber who has travelled from the Mushroom Kingdom to meet Sonic in Vancouver and compete in the Olympic Winter Games. Amongst a number of his abilities, Mario brings with him his unique Spin on the Wii and the Spinning Jump and Fire Dash on the DS, and is expected to show an outstanding performance in every event as an all-round player!

Luigi is the taller and younger twin brother of Mario. He has been on many adventures with Mario and now comes to Vancouver to compete in the ultimate winter competition. Using the Luigi Rocket technique on the Wii and DS or Green Fire Dash on the DS, he brings a unique advantage that he hopes will propel him to the top.

Yoshi is Mario’s friend living on Yoshi Island and usually accompanies Mario and Luigi on their adventures. Yoshi will put forward great effort in the Olympic Winter Games with his Flutter Jump ability on the Wii and DS and Thrash Dash ability on the DS.

Peach is a princess in the Mushroom Kingdom. Although kidnapped many times by Bowser, Peach is going toe-to-toe with the other competitors in the Olympic Winter Games. Nimble and graceful, she has the unique Mid-Air Float ability on the Wii and DS, and the Princess Dash ability on the DS that allows her to join in the competition with graceful technique.

Donkey Kong is a new addition to Team Mario. With both strength and agility, this powerful competitor cannot wait to try his unique skills in this winter wonderland of Vancouver and Whistler. Donkey Kong comes ready for the challenge with his Spinning Kong ability on the DS and the Hand Slap Dash on the Wii and DS.

Sonic the Hedgehog is the blue hedgehog that moves at Sonic speed who joins Mario as they go head-to-head at the Olympic Winter Games! Armed with his signature attitude and Spin Dash ability on the Wii and DS, and Jump Dash ability on the DS, Sonic brings a new level of competition to the Olympic Winter Games as his team goes for gold in Vancouver!

Miles “Tails” Prower is Sonic’s best friend and always at his side. An ace pilot and mechanic, Tails returns to the Olympic Games with the Tailspin Flight ability on the Wii and DS to spin his tails like a helicopter and propel himself in the air, as well as the Propeller Dash ability on the DS.

Knuckles the Echidna has been friend and foe to Sonic for years. He has protected the Master Emerald on Angel Island, but now has his eye on a new prize: being #1 in the Olympic Winter Games! Powerful and determined, Knuckles will be going for gold with his Screw Driver ability on the Wii and DS, and Spiral Uppercut ability on the DS.

Amy Rose is both graceful and powerful and a valuable member of Sonic’s crew. While she tends to find herself following Sonic, Amy has come to the Olympic Winter Games to be a serious competitor! With the Pink Typhoon ability on the Wii and DS, and the Rose Spin ability on the DS, Amy hopes to win over Sonic by bringing home the gold!

Metal Sonic is new to the world of the Olympic Games. Modelled with extreme accuracy to Sonic by Dr. Eggman, Metal Sonic is one of our blue hero’s earliest foes. At the Olympic Winter Games, Metal Sonic hopes to gain an advantage with his unique ability on the Wii and DS known as the Air Boost.
